'''Inania''', officially the '''Kingdom of Inania''', is a country in [[North Mahea]]. It has coastlines on the [[Hinsakian Ocean]] to the east, and has land borders with [[Deschon]] to the north; [[Jathua]], [[Taoisia]], Rtesania and [[Ozinia]] to the west; [[Lieri]] along with [[Pelugrotoa]] to the south. Inania covers a land area of 2,964,408 km2 (1,144,564 sq mi). As of 1765, it has around 236 million inhabitants, making it the [[List of countries and dependencies by population|7th-most populous country in the world]]. Its capital is [[Fashti]], while its second largest city is [[Varnan]].

The region constituting Inania has been inhabited since the [[Palaeolithic]] era, more than 300,000 years ago. The [[Ranoteisid dynasty]] was established by [[Ranoteisid I of Inania|Ranoteisid I]] in 831, and Inania was subsequently ruled by a series of other independent dynasties, reaching its zenith as a [[regional power]] in the 11th and 12th centuries, under the [[Illyllo dynasty|Illyllo]] and [[Hainanu dynasty|Hainanu]] dynasties, both Huan kingdoms, when it controlled most of the [[Serenr Steppe]]. In the 13th and 14th centuries, Inania faced external threats to its sovereignty, with [[Sivosan Empire|Sivoso]] seizing some territory and the [[Pelugrotoa]] encroaching from the south. The Yadai dynasty expanded its territory through the [[Inania invasion of the Undoson|conquest]] of the [[Undoson]] in the late 16th century. The [[Lorvor dynasty]], which rules the country to this day, seized power in 1422, and over the next two centuries expanded [[diplomatic]] and commercial relations with the [[Northern world]]. In the late 16th century, the Kuwana Dynasty of Ashain set up settlements on the coast of the Undoson. In 1613, Easuhura established trade outposts over the country and diplomatic quarters in the capital [[Fashti]]. 

Inania lost its sovereignty in 1675, when [[Pelugrotoa]] invaded during the [[Inanian Succession War]], and following Succession's defeat, Pelugrotoa gained large influence in the government of the nation. It remained neutral during the [[Red War]], though it regained control of the colonial outposts after the war. The nation has remained close to [[Pelugrotoa]], who has massive economic control over the Inanian Economy. Since then, Inania has suffered from prolonged and unsolved [[Ethnic discrimination in Inania|inter-ethnic clashes]] and political instability marked by [[wikipedia:civil conflict|civil conflict]]. 

Inania is a [[Multinational state|multi-ethnic state]] with over 50 different [[List of ethnic groups in Inania|ethnic groups]]. [[Thessovai]] is the most widely professed faith in the country, with the largest denomination being the [[Inania Thessovai Church]], followed by None and a small percentage of [[Traditional Acrolan religion|traditional faiths]]. The country is a founding member of the GTU, also becoming a full member of [[PSI]] in 1744. Inania is sometimes considered an [[wikipedia:emerging power|emerging power]], having the [[List of Mahean countries by GDP growth|fastest economic growth]] in [[North Mahea]]n countries because of [[foreign direct investment]] in expansion of agricultural and manufacturing industries, undergoing the fatsts urbanisation of any nation; [[Agriculture in Inania|agriculture]] is the country's seoncd largest economic sector, accounting for over 17% of the [[wikipedia:gross domestic product|GDP]] as of 1764. Although the Inanian economy has experienced consistent growth, in terms of [[wikipedia:per capita income|per capita income]]. Inania faces numerous challenges, including high rates of [[Poverty in Inania|poverty]], [[Human rights in Inania|human rights]] violations, widespread [[Ethnic discrimination in Inania|ethnic discrimination]], and a literacy rate of 75%.
